dogecoin.text: @AnnaAkana For months I didn't tell my wife that, on a whim, I bought $20K worth of a cryptocurrency that has a Shiba Inu as a mascot. It just sounded too idiotic. When it hit $.42 I casually asked if she had ever heard of dogecoin. I looked like a genius (at least for a minute).

@flankded He means that #dogecoin will pass bitcoin in market cap. To do that, doge would need to hit ~$5.60. But this is at today's $BTC price. If Ethereum becomes the preferred SOV, then BTC will fall. At ~$20K for BTC, doge would need to hit ~$2.80, which is high but not inconceivable.
